name: spec-row
description: One label/value pair: a technical-data row, a variant attribute.

view.name: SpecRow
view.notes: Context-rendered by the parent: in an accordion item = 2-col row (label left, value right-aligned; ft 16/22 300 var(--color-secondary), row pitch 42px, 1px var(--color-panel-strong) divider); in a product-variant = a table cell (first 4 rows) or a 'Merkmale' detail pair (all rows).
